purpose: Observe a Termux:X11 Linux desktop through a landscape Quest 2D viewer panel.
authority_boundary: Termux remains a normal Android app sidecar.
The Android viewer is observation-only and does not become HOME, a broker authority, or a shell authority.
VNC and MJPEG bridge exposure stays on loopback by default.
preflight: Meta Quest workflow is active for live device operations.
Termux, Termux:X11, and a desktop session are installed by the operator.
The X display is configured for an exact landscape root such as 1280x720 before the desktop starts.
The VNC server binds to device localhost only.
The host MJPEG bridge is bound to host localhost only.
start: Start Termux:X11 and the desktop session.
Start x11vnc against the X display with localhost-only binding.
Forward VNC from the device to the host.
Start the host MJPEG bridge against the forwarded VNC port.
Reverse the host MJPEG bridge back to device loopback on the same port.
Launch the landscape Android VNC panel viewer.
status: MJPEG status endpoint reports the expected landscape dimensions.
Headset-visible viewer panel shows the full desktop width without left-slice cropping.
Headset-panel evidence and direct stream evidence are captured as separate artifact types.
stop: Remove the reverse and forward port mappings.
Stop the desktop session when the lab run is complete.
cleanup: Confirm no VNC listener remains exposed beyond loopback.
Confirm no stale Android task resize state is being relied on.
Record whether the viewer panel or Termux:X11 panel was the headset-visible witness.
evidence: Headset screenshot of the landscape viewer panel.
risks: MJPEG rendering support can vary across Android WebView versions.
ADB reverse requires an external authorized ADB host for this lab route.
The viewer panel observes pixels only; it does not provide desktop input forwarding.
